intro: West of the Tapi, the Adajan, Pal & Rander zone gathers five localities of the municipal West Zone: Adajan, Pal, Palanpur, Rander and Jahangirpura. Adajan, split into the Adajan Gam and Adajan Patiya ward areas, has mid-segment flats and a good number of independent homes. Pal and Palanpur, near Palanpur Jakatnaka and Bhesan Road, are almost entirely multi-storey societies of two- and three-bedroom flats, with business parks close by. Rander is far older than the port city itself; its merchants once traded across the Indian Ocean, and its core of narrow lanes and family houses is now circled by newer lift buildings. Jahangirpura, near Variav and Dabholi, mixes flats with self-built houses on plots.

Most tutors reach this bank by road or bus, because the metro is not running yet. The Green Line, with stations planned at Bhesan, Palanpur Road and Adajan Gam, is under construction. Meanwhile the Sitilink BRTS does real work: corridors run from Adajan Patiya to Jahangirpura and to Pal RTO, one crosses the city from Pal RTO, and another reaches Jahangirpura from the Katargam side. Autos are easy to find. The slow part of any journey is the river itself, since the bridges to Athwa fill at office hours, so a tutor who already lives west of the Tapi usually keeps the steadiest timetable.

NXTutors reflects that by listing tutors from Adajan, Pal, Palanpur, Rander and Jahangirpura before anyone else, then tutors who travel to this bank, then the rest of Surat, then online tutors from across India. For senior board subjects, many families here combine a nearby home tutor with an online specialist. You get two or three matched profiles, each with the tutor's own fee shown before booking, and the first lesson with the one you choose is a free demo. If later you feel another tutor would suit your child better, the change costs nothing and a new match is lined up.
faqs: Is the Surat Metro running in Adajan or Pal yet?

No. The Green Line, from Bhesan to Saroli, has stations planned at Bhesan, Palanpur Road and Adajan Gam, but it is still under construction and carries no passengers. Tutors reach this bank by Sitilink bus, auto or two-wheeler, and the BRTS corridors from Adajan Patiya and Pal RTO cover much of it.
What makes Rander different from the rest of the zone?

Its age. Rander was a trading settlement long before Surat became a port, and its old core still has narrow lanes of family houses. A tutor can usually walk to the door there, though parking may be a little way off; the newer apartment blocks around the core have a gate desk instead.
How do tutors get to Jahangirpura?

By bus, auto or two-wheeler. Two Sitilink BRTS corridors end at Jahangirpura, one from Adajan Patiya and one from the Katargam side, so buses link it with both banks of the Tapi. Utran is the nearest railway station. The first phase of the metro does not reach this area.
What will a home tutor in Adajan cost?

That depends on the class, subject and the tutor, who sets the fee and shows it before the demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: Five localities form the old core south of the river: Nanpura, Majura Gate, Athwa, Ghod Dod Road and Parle Point. Nanpura, near Kailash Nagar and Athwa Gate, still feels like the old city, with apartments, builder floors and older independent houses side by side. Majura Gate is a Ring Road junction of offices, shops and mid-segment flats. Athwa, including Athwalines, has ready apartments, independent houses and some plots, and faces Adajan across a cable-stayed bridge. Ghod Dod Road is a long shopping street with a premium belt of three-bedroom flats behind it, and Parle Point, at its southern end, is a busy junction of cafés and restaurants with apartments around it.

For tutoring, this zone's advantage is simply being central. Tutors from Adajan, Piplod, City Light and the old city can all reach it without a long ride, and Surat railway station, built in 1860, and Udhna Junction are the rail points nearby. Sitilink buses, autos and cabs cover the main roads. On the metro map, Majura Gate is where the two lines under construction will cross, and the Green Line also has a stop planned at Athwa Chopati. What families here plan around is the shopping crowd: Ghod Dod Road and Parle Point fill up in the evening, and narrow lanes in Nanpura make parking a car difficult.

Because so many tutors can reach the centre, the NXTutors shortlist for these localities can draw on a wide pool. It starts with tutors living in the zone, then adds tutors who travel here, then the rest of Surat, and finally online tutors anywhere in India. Two or three tutors who suit your child are sent to you, fees included, and the lesson with your chosen one is a free demo, at home or on screen. Lessons fixed straight after school usually beat the evening rush on the shopping streets. If you want a different tutor later, switching is free, and the next match is arranged for you.
faqs: Which localities are in the Central Surat, Athwa & Ghod Dod Road zone?

Five: Nanpura, Majura Gate, Athwa, Ghod Dod Road and Parle Point, all south of the river. Nanpura keeps the older city's mix of houses and flats, Ghod Dod Road and Parle Point are busy commercial stretches with apartments behind them, and Athwa faces Adajan across the river.
Where does the name Ghod Dod Road come from?

It means horse racing, after races held on the road in the 1900s. The road runs from Majura Gate to Parle Point and was rebuilt as a retail hub in the 1980s. For tutoring, the key point is that shoppers fill it in the evening, so time lessons for just after school.
Will Majura Gate be on the metro?

Yes, once it opens. Both planned metro lines, the Red and the Green, are designed to meet at Majura Gate, making it an interchange once services begin. Neither line carries passengers yet, so tutors come by Sitilink bus, auto or two-wheeler for now, and the rail points remain Surat station and Udhna Junction.
Can we meet the tutor before paying anything?

Yes. The first class with the tutor you choose from your two or three matches is a free demo, so you and your child can judge the teaching before any fee applies. Each tutor's fee is on their profile beforehand, and changing tutor later is free.

intro: The newer south-western side of Surat forms this zone: Piplod, City Light, Vesu and the residential belt along Dumas Road. Piplod is upmarket, with ready apartments and villas around Kargil Chowk. City Light, close to Parle Point and Althan, is mostly two- and three-bedroom flats in multi-storey societies. Vesu is one of the city's newest expansions, with high-rise gated complexes, many at the luxury end, alongside business parks and shopping centres, and Bhimrad next to it. Dumas Road runs south-west towards Magdalla, the airport and the beach on the Arabian Sea, lined with mid-segment gated societies, with Gaviyar and Rundh-Magdalla among the ward areas nearby.

Almost every family here lives in a gated society, so the gate comes first. Security desks typically note each new visitor, so passing the tutor's name and flat number ahead of the demo avoids a wait at the barrier. On the travel side, Gaurav Path, the wide road through Piplod towards the airport, has a lane reserved for BRTS buses, which lets a tutor who does not drive come in by Sitilink. Test trains are running on part of the Red Line, which is planned to serve VIP Road, Bhimrad and Convention Center on its way to Dream City, but the line has not opened, and the last part of most journeys is still by auto or two-wheeler.

When a family in this part of Surat asks NXTutors for a tutor, those living in Piplod, City Light, Vesu or along Dumas Road come first, followed by tutors who travel here, then the rest of the city, then online tutors from anywhere in India. You get two or three profiles that match your child's class, board and timetable, each with a visible fee, and your first lesson is a free demo. Office hours, and weekend evenings on the beach road, are when VIP Road and Dumas Road jam, so weekday lessons clear of those windows tend to last. Switching tutor later is free.
faqs: Can a tutor reach Piplod by bus?

Yes. Piplod sits on Gaurav Path, the expressway out towards the airport and Magdalla, which has its own BRTS lane, so a tutor who does not drive can ride a Sitilink bus in. Autos and cabs are plentiful for the final stretch from the bus stop to your gate, including around Kargil Chowk.
Has the metro opened in Vesu?

Not for passengers. Test trains have been running since March 2026 on an elevated section of the Red Line near Dream City, and stops are planned at VIP Road and Bhimrad, but nobody can board yet. For now, a tutor coming to Vesu rides a two-wheeler, takes an auto or catches a Sitilink bus.
Does the metro run along Dumas Road?

No. The Red Line being built keeps to the VIP Road side of Vesu on its way to Dream City, away from Dumas Road, so families along that road will still rely on tutors who come by bus, auto or two-wheeler. Nearly all families here live in gated societies, where gate registration and a visitor entry are normal.
How does NXTutors decide which tutors to show a Vesu family?

By fit first, then distance. Tutors are matched to your child's class, board, subjects, timing and budget, and ordered with those living in the zone first, then those who travel here, the rest of Surat, and online. You see two or three with fees shown, and the demo is free.

intro: Surat's southern belt, where industrial estates sit next to affordable and mid-budget homes, makes up this zone: Udhna, Althan, Bhatar and Pandesara. Althan and Bhatar share one ward area; Althan, near New Althan and Bhatar Char Rasta, is mostly two- and three-bedroom flats, and Bhatar, between Ghod Dod Road and Althan, has many one- and two-bedroom flats. Udhna, also written Udhana, lies mainly along the Surat-Navsari highway, with affordable flats and houses among several industrial estates. Pandesara, once a village, is now a hub of industry and trade where many families also live, in a housing board colony, small apartment blocks and houses.

Trains and buses serve this side well. Udhna Junction connects to both main lines through the city and to the Jalgaon line, Bhestan station is close by, and Surat's first BRTS corridor, opened in January 2014, starts at Udhana Darwaja and heads south towards Sachin. The metro is being tested on a raised section ending at Althan, though it is not yet open to riders. When fixing a lesson time, remember that factory shifts load the highway and estate roads as heavily as office traffic does; and for Althan, tutors living on the same side of the Tapi avoid the bridges altogether.

NXTutors lists tutors living in Udhna, Althan, Bhatar or Pandesara first, then tutors who travel into this belt, then others in Surat, then online tutors from across India, which many families use for specialist subjects. Two or three matched tutors come back to you, and each fee is shown before the free demo is booked. In the older blocks there is rarely a gate process, whereas the societies of Althan and Bhatar keep a register at the entrance. If your child later needs someone different, for a new class or subject, switching tutor is free.
faqs: Which railway stations serve Udhna?

Udhna Junction lies inside the locality and handles trains on both main lines through the city as well as the line to Jalgaon; Bhestan station is also nearby. Tutors who come by train take an auto from the station, and the Sitilink corridor from Udhana Darwaja runs along this side of the city.
Is Althan the first part of Surat to get the metro?

It is where testing started. Trains began trial running on 29 March 2026 over the raised section from Dream City up to Althan, and the Red Line plans two stops in the locality, at Althan Gam and Althan Tenament. No part was open to passengers at our last check, so tutors still travel by bus, auto or two-wheeler.
When should lessons be fixed in Pandesara?

Away from shift-change hours. Pandesara's industrial roads are busiest when shifts start and end, so agree a class time that avoids them. Udhna Junction is the nearest railway station, and the first phase of the metro does not serve Pandesara. Families often add online classes for specialist subjects.
Can the same tutor teach at home and online?

Yes. Many tutors on NXTutors offer both, so a family in Udhna or Pandesara can keep a weekly home lesson and move another online on days when shift traffic is heavy. The first demo is free in either format, fees are shown up front, and switching tutor is free.

intro: North and east of the Tapi, the Katargam, Varachha & Sarthana zone covers Katargam, Amroli, Varachha, Mota Varachha, Sarthana and Yogi Chowk. This is the diamond side of Surat. Katargam, a nagar panchayat until it joined the city, now holds the North Zone office, a riverside promenade known as the Causeway and neighbourhoods such as Narayan Nagar. Varachha is a hub of diamond cutting and polishing and embroidery units, with closely built areas such as Matavadi and Trikamnagar. Amroli joined the city in 2006. Mota Varachha and Sarthana have newer multi-storey societies, and Yogi Chowk, near Simada Gam and Punagam, has ready flats around busy shopping streets.

For tutoring, work patterns shape the day more than anything else. Diamond-unit shifts fill the lanes of Katargam and Varachha as they start and end, and the shopping streets around Yogi Chowk are busy in the evening, so a slot that begins after those waves is easier to keep. Most tutors arrive by road. Three railway stations, Surat, Utran and Kosad, sit around the zone, two BRTS corridors reach its far corners at Kosad and Sarthana Jakat Naka, and autos are never hard to find. The Red Line metro will start at Sarthana and pass Nature Park and Kapodra, but it is still under construction.

NXTutors starts a search for this zone with tutors who live in it, then tutors who travel here from other parts of Surat, then the wider city, and then online tutors across India. On the northern fringe, in Amroli and Mota Varachha, a local tutor for day-to-day study plus an online teacher for one harder senior subject is a common arrangement. Each request brings back two or three tutors, with what each charges shown up front, and a free first lesson with the one you pick. Entry is simple in most of the older, smaller blocks. If the tutor later stops suiting your child, moving to another is free.
faqs: Where will the Surat Metro Red Line start?

At Sarthana, its eastern terminus. The Red Line is planned to run through Nature Park, Varachha Chopati Garden and Kapodra, then underground through Labheshwar Chowk and Surat Railway Station, on to Dream City. It is still under construction and carries no passengers, so tutors reach Sarthana by BRTS, auto or two-wheeler.
How do diamond-unit shifts affect lesson times in Katargam?

Workshop shifts starting and finishing crowd the lanes, so a lesson timed to coincide with them often begins late. Families in Katargam and Varachha usually agree an evening slot that begins after the shift rush, and keep it fixed so the tutor can plan the journey.
Which railway stations are near Amroli and Mota Varachha?

Utran and Kosad are the nearest stations for both, and the Sitilink corridor from Katargam Darwaja to Kosad serves Amroli. The first phase of the metro does not reach either area. Tutors from Katargam, Sarthana and Varachha can reach them easily by road, and a nearby landmark helps on the first visit.
What should we look for in the free demo class?

Whether the tutor explains a topic your child finds difficult in a way they follow, sets useful practice, and knows how your board marks answers. The demo is with the tutor you pick from two or three matches; if it is not right, the next tutor can take a demo too.
